_comment: Registry of converted skills for shared/scripts/tools/check_prompt_mechanics.py (programme P12). A skill listed here has its mechanics in code; its SKILL.md may hold only the registered commands, one per fenced shell block. 'commands' are command keys (the words before the first flag); a command not listed is a new shell command (C5). 'escapes' name a block that may hold several commands, by its exact normalised command lines; each needs a reason, a stale one is a finding, and the count may never exceed 'escape_budget' - lower the budget when an escape goes, never raise it. Adding a skill here is the last step of its conversion.

escapes.reason: Step 4 shows the preview call and the real call of the same command side by side; one is the dry run of the other, no mechanic is decided in the prose.
